The final strategy is saved as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T152747Z/final_strategy.txt). PubMed returned **31,980 records** through the requested date cutoff, with no translation warnings.

It retrieved **9 of 9** screened records from a prior review’s references. That is relative recall against a small benchmark, not an estimate of sensitivity; no articles were supplied as seeds. The scope assumptions, line-by-line counts, screening notes, and critic findings are in the [audit](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/ours-codex-noseed-20260927T152747Z/work/audit.md).

This draft still needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
